tailoring.headline: Techno-Functional SAP Commerce Consultant | SAP Certified | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs
tailoring.summary: SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer with 5+ years of experience delivering enterprise e-commerce solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring Boot, and OCC REST APIs, with a proven track record in PIM/ERP/MDM integration and data pipeline optimization. I bridge the gap between business and IT by translating complex requirements into functional specifications and scalable SAP Commerce solutions. Skilled in agile delivery, production troubleshooting, and leveraging AI-assisted development to drive high-performance e-commerce platforms.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Senior Consultant/Architect | SAP CX
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in the Senior Consultant/Architect role at Instaffo. With over 5 years of hands-on experience delivering complex SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) solutions for global enterprises like Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am eager to bring my techno-functional expertise to your team.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Expertise
bullets.text: I have extensive experience architecting and implementing backend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud 2211, ensuring platform best practices and high-performance code.

bullets.label: Integration Mastery
bullets.text: I specialize in designing and optimizing data pipelines between PIM, ERP, and MDM systems, ensuring seamless synchronization across global e-commerce channels.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Delivery
bullets.text: I bridge the gap between business and technical teams by translating complex requirements into functional specifications and user stories for agile delivery.

bullets.label: API & Headless Development
bullets.text: I have successfully developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and headless APIs, enabling robust integrations for PWA frontends and third-party consumers.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe and hold a valid German residence and work permit. I am currently serving my notice period, with my last working day on 15 December 2026 and an earliest start date of 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my background aligns with your goals.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als Senior Consultant/Architect | SAP CX
cover_de.hook: mit großem Interesse bewerbe ich mich als Senior Consultant/Architect bei Instaffo. Durch meine über fünfjährige Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Implementierung von SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Lösungen bei Rockwell Automation und Shell bringe ich fundierte techno-funktionale Expertise mit.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Expertise
bullets.text: Ich verfüge über umfassende Erfahrung in der Konfiguration und Erweiterung von SAP Commerce Cloud 2211 unter Einhaltung technischer Best Practices.

bullets.label: Integrations-Know-how
bullets.text: Ich habe komplexe Datenpipelines zwischen PIM-, ERP- und MDM-Systemen entworfen und optimiert, um eine konsistente Datenhaltung sicherzustellen.

bullets.label: Techno-funktionale Beratung
bullets.text: Als Schnittstelle zwischen Business und IT übersetze ich komplexe Anforderungen in präzise funktionale Spezifikationen und User Stories.

bullets.label: API-Entwicklung
bullets.text: Ich habe erfolgreich OCC REST Web Services und Headless-APIs entwickelt, um performante E-Commerce-Plattformen und PWA-Frontends zu realisieren.

cover_de.logistics: Ich lebe in Karlsruhe und besitze eine gültige Arbeitserlaubnis. Mein letzter Arbeitstag ist der 15.12.2026, sodass ich ab dem 16.12.2026 zur Verfügung stehe. Gerne stelle ich mich Ihnen in einem persönlichen Gespräch vor.

tailoring.why_company: Instaffo's innovative approach to matching talent with high-growth companies resonates with my professional values. I am impressed by your commitment to digital transformation and excellence in the SAP CX ecosystem. I want to contribute my deep technical knowledge of SAP Commerce Cloud and my experience in bridging business requirements with scalable architecture to help your clients achieve their e-commerce goals.
tailoring.motivation_short: I am motivated by solving complex integration challenges and delivering high-performance e-commerce solutions that drive business value. I enjoy working in agile, international environments where I can apply my techno-functional skills to bridge the gap between IT and business.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I am an SAP Certified Commerce Developer with 5+ years of experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I am interested in the Senior Consultant/Architect role at Instaffo. My background in SAP CX, integrations, and business analysis is a great match for your team.
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Senior Consultant/Architect | SAP CX - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Senior Consultant/Architect position at Instaffo. With over 5 years of experience in SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) and a strong background in techno-functional consulting and API integrations, I am confident in my ability to contribute to your team's success. I am currently serving my notice period and am available to start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to the possibility of an interview.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
